document-type-description-0: This type of document allows you to create and manage your item for each month. With this functionality, you will be able to set financial goals, track your expenses and receipts, and have a clear view of your monthly financial planning.
document-type-description-1: This type of document is ideal to accompany your investments in assets, FII's and other assets. With this functionality, you will be able to record your purchases and sales of assets.
document-type-description-2: This document type works like a notepad where you can record different types of important information. Use this functionality to create shopping lists, quick notes, to-dos, or any other type of annotation what to wish for.
